Name: NecroMounts
Author: Necrofiend13
Description:
Here I have collated some preferred reskins, in some cases I've added new texture skins for the Horse. Made for convenience for 1.6+ using Generic Mod Config Menu.
The main advantage of this mod is to functionally switch between any skin you desire, without the need for an expanding list of mods within your play pack. Client side, so any and all members of a server can choose to use this mod, or not, with any preset desired.
Anything can be added / altered. Feel free to make requests / add your own sprites.
Featured in this collection:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/251?tab=description]Tan and Green Velociraptor
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/413]﻿Black Motorcycle and Headless Horse[/url]
